company_profile.typical_scope: Listed or systemically important company with multi-site operations, broad stakeholder exposure, and mature reporting expectations.
company_profile.expected_evidence_depth: policy, governance body, process, KPI trend, target, and assurance/readiness where available

answer_guidance.metrics_policy: Prefer multi-year quantitative metrics, targets, baselines, and progress explanations.
answer_guidance.governance_expectation: Identify board or executive oversight, committee roles, reporting cadence, and accountability owners.
answer_guidance.risk_management_expectation: Describe enterprise-wide risk process, scenario/impact assessment, controls, monitoring, and escalation.
answer_guidance.supply_chain_expectation: Include supplier standards, due diligence, audits, corrective actions, and high-risk supplier coverage where relevant.
answer_guidance.assurance_expectation: Mention internal controls, external assurance, certification, or verification readiness when evidence exists.
answer_guidance.fallback_when_evidence_missing: State the limitation clearly and avoid inventing policies, metrics, certifications, or targets.

question_adaptation_rules: Expand governance and risk answers with decision rights and oversight cadence.
For Metrics questions, request or use quantitative trend data rather than only describing activities.
For Strategy questions, connect the topic to enterprise strategy, financial resilience, and stakeholder expectations.
